02 / LEARN BY EXPLORING

A small change.
A different response.

Explore inherent flow characteristics.
An illustrative lab, independent of installed piping effects.

Each equal increment of travel produces an equal percentage change in flow capacity.

RELATIVE CAPACITY14.1%
Theoretical normalized curves at constant pressure drop. Equal percentage uses R^(x−1) with a shutoff endpoint; quick opening uses √x as an illustration. Not a valve sizing tool.
